description: Near-separation: y = 1(x1 > 0) with the two points closest to 0 flipped, so the MLE is finite but the slope is large and fitted probabilities reach 0 and 1.
generator_code:
{
    n <- 100L
    d <- data.frame(x0 = 1, x1 = rnorm(n))
    d$y <- as.integer(d$x1 > 0)
    d$y[which(d$x1 == min(d$x1[d$x1 > 0]))] <- 0L
    d$y[which(d$x1 == max(d$x1[d$x1 < 0]))] <- 1L
    d
}
